findings.title: Check future app DNS uniqueness using case-insensitive names
findings.trigger: A selected front peer has an uppercase or mixed-case alias/container name equal to the lowercase future app_name under Docker DNS rules.
findings.actual: The new checker compares peer Name and Aliases case-sensitively, so these peers pass. Moby lowercases DNS service keys and queries, so future app_name is not unique and proxy DNS can select a different endpoint.
findings.minimumCorrection: Normalize only peer conflict comparisons consistently with Docker DNS lowercase semantics, for Name and Aliases. Keep the exact complete raw PG alias-set comparison, immutable PG identity/namespace/lease/source/record bindings and read-only network behavior. Change original helper/test and required consumer hash registrations only; no network mutation or scope expansion.
findings.limits: Local original-function Docker/proc/record model and upstream Moby source, not actual Docker/DNS traffic or measured production conflict.
